text: SEPA direct debit for German checkout - 28 FEB
description:
Direct debit (Lastschrift) is the default payment method for roughly a third of German shoppers. Not offering it wasn't losing us the payment — it was losing us the basket, at the moment of highest intent.

Shipped with a Schufa-backed risk check so we can offer it to first-time buyers without eating the chargeback risk.

text: PSD2 strong customer authentication rollout - Q1 2026
description: Regulatory, non-negotiable. The interesting part was the exemption engine: low-risk transactions under €30 skip the challenge entirely, which is why the failure rate went down rather than up.

text: 3-D Secure step-up only for risky baskets - 14 APR
description: We were challenging every card payment because it was the simplest thing to build. Scoring the basket first means 78% of shoppers never see a challenge screen at all.

text: Austrian EPS bank transfer - 22 MAY
description: Austria's equivalent of iDEAL. Small integration, and the market expects it.

text: Refund SLA cut to 3 working days - 31 JUL
description:
Refunds used to wait for the returned parcel to be scanned at the central warehouse, which meant up to eleven days. We now refund on carrier receipt and reconcile afterwards.

The finance risk turned out to be about a tenth of what everyone assumed — the reconciliation gap is under 0.3% of refund value.

text: One-page checkout redesign - Mid MAR
description:
Collapsed the four-step funnel into a single scrollable page with inline validation. Every step we removed was a step people were leaving on.

A/B tested at 50/50 for three weeks before the full ramp.
enablerNote: Unblocks every future one-tap wallet

text: Address autocomplete for France and Germany - 08 APR
description: Mistyped addresses were the second-largest cause of failed deliveries, and every failed delivery is a redelivery cost plus a contact.

text: Cart persistence across devices - 19 MAY
description: People browse on a phone at lunch and buy on a laptop in the evening. Until May those were two unrelated carts.

text: Inline promo-code validation - 26 JUN
description: Three days of work for one of the better conversion results of the half. The old flow validated the code on submit and cleared the whole form when it failed.

text: Passwordless magic-link sign-in - 10 APR
description: Password resets were our single largest contact driver — more tickets than delivery chasing. Magic links removed the category rather than optimising it.

text: Rate limiting and credential-stuffing defence - 15 MAR
description: We were seeing bursts of 40K sign-in attempts an hour against reused credentials from an unrelated breach. Now rate-limited per-account and per-ASN, with a challenge rather than a hard block.
enablerNote: Baseline for any stored-credential feature

text: GDPR account deletion self-service - 24 JUL
description: Deletion requests were a manual runbook across six systems with a 30-day clock and no tracking. It was a compliance finding waiting to happen.

text: Typo-tolerant search on the PLP - 22 MAY
description: "Sweatshit" now returns sweatshirts. Roughly one in nine apparel searches contains a typo, and every one of them used to return an empty page.

text: Faceted filtering by fit and fabric - 30 APR
description: Apparel shoppers filter by things a generic ecommerce facet set doesn't have: rise, leg shape, sleeve length, whether it's actually cotton.

text: Search-as-you-type suggestions - 11 JUN
Synonym dictionary for apparel terms - 07 AUG
description: "Jumper", "pullover", "sweater" and "Pulli" are the same garment to a shopper and were four different result sets to us. Curated by merchandising rather than learned, deliberately — the vocabulary is small and the cost of a wrong synonym is high.

text: Unified size chart across FR and DE catalogues - End of JUNE
description: The same jumper was listed as M in France and 38 in Germany, with no mapping between them. Merchandising maintained the two by hand, and they disagreed about 8% of the time.
enablerNote: Prerequisite for AI fit recommendations

text: Bulk product-data import from suppliers - 20 FEB
description: Onboarding a new supplier's season used to be four days of spreadsheet wrangling. It's now a validated upload with a diff preview.

text: Model-worn imagery on every PDP - 27 MAR
description: Flat-lay only was fine for basics and hopeless for anything with drape. Studio pipeline change more than an engineering one.

text: Fabric composition and care data - 15 MAY
enablerNote: Feeds the sustainability filters

text: Automated image background removal - 05 AUG
description: About 11,000 images a season were being cut out by hand at an agency. The model does it in the ingest pipeline; the agency now only handles the ones it flags as uncertain.

text: Carrier-agnostic label printing - Q2 2026
description: One label service, four carriers behind it. Switching a route used to be a deploy; it's now a config change, which is what made the same-day pilot conceivable at all.
enablerNote: Enables the same-day delivery pilot

text: Order tracking page with carrier events - 18 MAR
description: "Where is my order" was 40% of contacts. Showing the carrier scan events on our own tracking page took a visible bite out of that before the chatbot ever touched it.

text: Warehouse pick-path optimisation - 12 JUN
description: Reordering the pick list by physical location rather than SKU. Twelve minutes off the average multi-item order.

text: Split shipments for multi-warehouse orders - 29 JUL
description: Previously an order containing one out-of-stock item waited for all of it. Now it ships in parts, and the tracking page explains why.

text: Self-service returns portal - 30 JUN
description: Customers book their own return, print their own label, and see the refund clock start. Previously all three of those were an email to an agent.

text: Help centre rebuild with search - 24 FEB
description: The old help centre had 340 articles and no working search, which is the same as having no help centre.

text: Order-status chatbot for the top 5 intents - 17 APR
description: Deliberately narrow. Five intents it answers well, and an obvious route to a human for everything else — which is the opposite of how the previous attempt was scoped.

text: Agent desktop consolidation - 22 MAY
description: Agents had six tabs open to answer one question. Now three, and the order history is in the same place as the conversation.

text: CSAT survey after every resolved ticket - 03 JUL
enablerNote: Gives the AI triage work a baseline to beat

text: WhatsApp support channel for France - 31 JUL
description: French customers overwhelmingly prefer messaging to email, and were using our Instagram DMs as a support channel because we hadn't given them a real one.

text: Native wishlist with push price alerts - 12 MAY
description: Apparel shoppers wait for the sale. Now we tell them when it starts instead of hoping they come back and check.

text: App rebuild on a shared design system - 27 MAR
description: Two apps that looked like two companies. The rebuild was mostly about making every subsequent app change cheap, and it has.
enablerNote: Halves the cost of every later app feature

text: Biometric unlock for returning users - 26 JUN
Consent-mode v2 analytics migration - Q1 2026
description: Unglamorous and completely load-bearing. Without it, every downstream personalisation model is training on data we aren't allowed to use.
enablerNote: Legal basis for all personalisation work

text: Event schema and tracking plan - 13 FEB
description: Four teams had four names for "added to basket". Now one schema, enforced at the SDK, with a review step before a new event ships.
enablerNote: Every dashboard and model downstream depends on this

text: Self-serve dashboards for trading - 21 APR
description: Trading were asking analysts for the same six numbers every morning.

text: Marketing attribution model v2 - 10 JUL
description: Last-click was quietly telling us to spend everything on brand search. The new model is not perfect either, but it is wrong in less expensive ways.

text: Apple Pay & Google Pay one-tap - 15 SEP
description: Wallet payments skip address entry, card entry and the SCA challenge in one move. This is the payoff for the one-page checkout work — it only became a small change because that landed first.

text: Klarna pay-in-3 for Austria - 30 OCT
description:
Austria is our smallest market and our highest average basket, which is exactly the profile that responds to instalments.

**At risk:** Klarna's Austrian entity needs a separate merchant agreement and legal have had it for five weeks.

text: PayPal express from the product page - 09 OCT
description: Buy without ever seeing the basket. Works for the single-item impulse purchase, which is a third of our mobile orders.

text: Dunning and retry logic for failed payments - 27 NOV
description: About 4% of card payments fail for recoverable reasons — a soft decline, an expired card, a temporary issuer outage. We currently treat all of them as final.

text: Multi-currency pricing for the NL launch - Mid DEC
description:
The Netherlands is euro, so this is really about rounding rules, price-point psychology per market and tax display — none of which our pricing service models today.

**At risk:** competes directly with peak freeze for engineering time.
enablerNote: Blocks the full NL launch

text: Guest checkout with express address lookup - Mid OCT
description: Forcing account creation before purchase is the oldest self-inflicted conversion wound in ecommerce. Guest checkout, then an optional one-tap account claim on the confirmation page.

text: Basket-level delivery promise - 21 OCT
description: Show the actual delivery date in the basket, computed from stock location and carrier cut-off, rather than a generic "2–4 working days".

text: Gift options and gift messaging - 13 NOV
description: Timed for peak deliberately. Gift wrap, a message card, and hiding the price on the packing slip.

text: Peak-load hardening for Black Friday - 07 NOV
description:
Last year checkout degraded for 40 minutes on the Friday evening at roughly 6× baseline traffic. Load testing to 10×, queue-based inventory reservation, and a graceful degradation path that keeps checkout up even if recommendations fall over.

**At risk:** the load-test environment still doesn't mirror production's database topology, so the numbers we're getting aren't trustworthy yet.
enablerNote: Protects the single biggest trading weekend of the year

text: Passkeys (WebAuthn) rollout - Q4 2026
description:
The natural successor to magic links: no email round-trip, phishing-resistant, and it makes the loyalty SSO work in Q1 tractable.

**At risk:** cross-device sync behaviour still differs enough between iOS, Android and Windows that our fallback logic is more complex than the happy path.
enablerNote: Prerequisite for loyalty SSO

text: Session hardening and device list - 20 NOV
description: Let people see where they're signed in and revoke a session. Table stakes for anything holding a stored card.
enablerNote: Required before card vaulting ships

text: Social sign-in with Apple and Google - 16 OCT
description: Requested constantly in research. Sign in with Apple is also a store requirement now that we offer any third-party sign-in at all.

text: Step-up auth for high-value orders - 04 DEC
Visual search: shop the look from a photo - Q4 2026
description:
Upload or snap a photo, get the closest things we sell. The demo is genuinely impressive.

**Blocked:** the licence on the embedding model doesn't clearly permit commercial use on user-uploaded images. Legal review has been open since July and we are not starting the integration until it closes.
enablerNote: Opens the whole inspiration-led shopping surface

text: Personalised ranking on the PLP - 02 DEC
description: Same result set, reordered by what this shopper has engaged with. Deliberately ranking-only for now — filtering the catalogue per person is a much bigger promise and a much worse failure mode.

text: Out-of-stock demotion in results - 25 SEP
description: We currently show sold-out sizes in the grid with no indication, which produces a click, a disappointment and an exit.

text: AI fit recommendations from returns data - 05 DEC
description:
Apparel returns are overwhelmingly a size problem, not a taste problem — "too small" and "too big" are more than half our return reasons. We already have the ground truth in the returns log; we just weren't using it.

Model suggests a size from the customer's own return history plus the garment's measured tolerances.

text: Customer photo reviews on the PDP - 23 OCT
description: Photos of a garment on a real body, with the reviewer's height and usual size. Consistently the single most requested thing in fit research.

text: Sustainability attributes and filters - 11 NOV
description: Material provenance, recycled content and certification badges, filterable. Also gets ahead of the EU green-claims rules rather than scrambling later.
enablerNote: Pre-empts EU green-claims compliance

text: Size-and-fit copy from garment measurements - 28 NOV
description:
Generate "runs small, size up if between sizes" from actual measurement data rather than merchandiser intuition.

**At risk:** measurement data is only complete for about 60% of the catalogue, and backfilling it is a supplier conversation, not an engineering one.

text: Same-day delivery pilot in Paris - 18 NOV
description:
Three arrondissements, one micro-hub, cut-off at 13:00.

**At risk:** the carrier contract is unsigned and the micro-hub lease depends on it. Every week of delay pushes us closer to peak, and we will not launch a new delivery promise during Black Friday.

text: Parcel-locker delivery option - 30 SEP
description: Packstation is how a large share of German shoppers prefer to receive parcels, and it removes the failed-delivery case entirely.

text: Peak capacity plan with the 3PL - 24 OCT
description: Contracted volumes, surge staffing and a daily cut-off schedule agreed before November rather than negotiated during it.
enablerNote: Protects peak delivery promise

text: Returns fraud detection - 09 DEC
description:
Wardrobing and empty-parcel returns are a measurable and growing cost, concentrated in a very small number of accounts.

**Blocked:** any model that scores individual customers needs a DPIA, and one hasn't been scheduled. We are not building a system that flags people until the legal basis is written down.

text: Delivery promise on the PDP - 16 OCT
description: The same computed date as the basket promise, moved one step earlier in the journey.

text: AI triage for inbound tickets - Q4 2026
description: Classify, route, and auto-answer the top twelve intents. Deliberately *not* a chatbot on the storefront — this sits behind the queue, where a wrong answer costs us a re-route rather than a customer.

text: Proactive delivery-delay notifications - 14 OCT
description: We usually know a parcel is late before the customer does. Telling them first converts an angry contact into no contact at all.

text: Peak season contact deflection plan - 06 NOV
description:
Seasonal agent onboarding, extended hours, and a peak-specific help centre front page.

**At risk:** seasonal hiring is behind by about three weeks and the training runway is fixed.
enablerNote: Keeps peak CSAT from collapsing

text: Native app checkout parity - 30 NOV
description: The app still hands off to a web view at payment, which is where the drop-off is. Bringing checkout native closes a 9pp gap against the mobile web funnel.

text: Push notification preference centre - 07 OCT
description: We currently have one push toggle, so anyone who dislikes marketing pushes also loses delivery updates. Unsurprisingly, opt-out is high.

text: App-only early access to drops - 20 NOV
description: A concrete reason to install and keep the app, timed for the peak drop calendar.

text: Deep links from email and social - 25 SEP
description: Every marketing link currently dumps app users onto the mobile web homepage, which is an expensive way to lose a session.

text: Real-time recommendation service - Q4 2026
description: Recommendations currently refresh nightly, which means the model has no idea what you looked at four minutes ago. Moving to a streaming feature store fixes the session-level signal.
enablerNote: Feeds fit, search ranking and the app home

text: Homepage personalisation - 04 DEC
description: Category order and hero content by affinity. Held behind the real-time reco service, since a personalised homepage built on yesterday's data is worse than a merchandised one.

text: Email send-time optimisation - 21 OCT
Feature flag and experiment platform - 30 SEP
description: Every team is currently rolling its own flags, and nobody can answer "what experiments are running right now".
enablerNote: Every A/B test after this one gets cheaper

text: Customer lifetime value model - 27 NOV
description: Needed to stop bidding the same acquisition cost for a one-off sale shopper and a repeat full-price customer.
enablerNote: Sharpens paid media and retention spend

text: Data quality monitoring and alerting - 13 NOV
description:
Two of the last four bad trading decisions came from a silently broken pipeline rather than a wrong judgement.

**At risk:** genuinely important and repeatedly deprioritised in favour of things with a visible demo. It has slipped twice.
enablerNote: Makes every other number on this board trustworthy

text: Stored-card vaulting and network tokens - Q1 2027
description: Network tokens survive card reissues, so an expired-card event stops being a lost order. Depends on session hardening landing first.

text: Payment orchestration layer (dual PSP) - Q1 2027
description: One PSP is a single point of failure for all revenue. A thin orchestration layer lets us fail over, and gives us leverage at contract renewal.
enablerNote: Removes the single-PSP outage risk

text: Cart abandonment recovery flows - Mid FEB
description: Triggered email and push for carts left over €40, with a size-back-in-stock variant. Held until the real-time reco service lands so the recovery email can carry a useful alternative rather than the same sold-out item.

text: Save-for-later and price-drop watch - Q1 2027
Single sign-on for loyalty members - Q1 2027
description: One identity across the storefront, the app and the in-store tills. Only sensible once passkeys are the primary factor.
enablerNote: Unifies online and in-store customer records

text: Age verification for restricted categories - Q1 2027
description: Only relevant once the planned fragrance and alcohol gifting range launches, but it gates that launch entirely.

text: Natural-language search for occasion queries - Q1 2027
description: "Linen shirt for a wedding in Greece in August" is a query our current index cannot answer, and it is exactly how people describe what they actually want to buy.
enablerNote: Positions us ahead of marketplace search

text: Search relevance experimentation platform - Q1 2027
description: Right now every relevance change is argued about rather than measured.
enablerNote: Makes every later ranking change measurable

text: Catalogue expansion to Spain and Italy - 31 MAR
description: Two new markets, ~40K SKUs to localise, and a sizing standard that agrees with neither FR nor DE. The unified size chart is what makes this a translation job rather than a re-modelling job.

text: Automated PDP copy generation - Q1 2027
description: Draft product copy from attributes, reviewed by a human before publish. The review step is not optional — generated apparel copy is confidently wrong about fabric more often than you'd like.

text: Returns consolidation hubs - Q1 2027
description: Returns currently travel individually back to the central warehouse. Consolidating at three regional hubs cuts the return leg cost by about a third and gets stock back on sale roughly six days sooner.

text: Dutch-language support desk - Mid MAR
description: The NL soft launch is running on English-language support, which shows in the CSAT gap. Hiring two native speakers and localising the top 40 help articles.

text: Unified customer timeline in the agent desktop - Q1 2027
description: Orders, returns, contacts and refunds on one thread. Blocked behind the CDP consolidation, which owns the identity resolution.

text: Offline browsing and wishlist sync - Q1 2027
description: Commutes are prime browsing time and the Métro has no signal. Cache the last-viewed grid and let the wishlist queue writes until the connection comes back.

text: Home-screen widget for order tracking - Q1 2027
Customer data platform consolidation - Q1 2027
description:
Four systems currently believe they own the customer record and none of them agree.

**At risk:** scope has grown twice since January — it now quietly includes loyalty, consent and the email platform. This needs a hard cut before it starts, not after.

text: Server-side tagging migration - Q1 2027
description: Ad-blockers and ITP are eating an increasing share of client-side events. Moving collection server-side recovers the signal and cuts about 300ms off page load.

text: Crypto and stablecoin settlement pilot
description: Deprioritised in June. Demand testing found essentially no overlap between our customer base and people wanting to pay for a jumper in stablecoin. Parked rather than killed — revisit if the regulatory picture changes.

text: Buy-now-pay-later aggregator
description: Rather than integrating each BNPL provider by hand, route to whichever one approves the shopper. Only worth it once we have three or more live.

text: Delegated access for household accounts
description: One payment method and address book, several people. Comes up constantly in family gifting research and has nowhere to live in the current identity model.

text: In-store kiosk search integration
description: Search the full online catalogue from a screen in the shop, order to home from the till. Depends on loyalty SSO for the customer record.

text: 3D garment viewer and virtual try-on - Q3 2027
description: The genuinely ambitious one. Needs 3D capture in the studio pipeline, which is a merchandising operations change far more than an engineering one — and that is the part nobody has costed yet.
enablerNote: Would halve size-related returns if it works

text: Carbon-neutral delivery option
description: Offsetting is the easy version and increasingly seen through. The credible version is route and packaging change, which is a much longer conversation with the 3PL.

text: Voice support agent for order status
description: "Where is my order" is 40% of calls and needs no judgement at all. Sequenced after the AI triage work proves the intent classification is trustworthy.

text: In-app styling appointments
description: Piloted with 40 customers in May and parked. The booking experience worked; the operational model didn't — we don't have stylists, and hiring them is a different business.

text: On-device personalisation - Q4 2027
description: Keep the behavioural signal on the phone and ship the model to it, rather than shipping the behaviour to us. Better privacy posture, and it stops the personalisation roadmap being hostage to consent rates.
enablerNote: Removes the consent-rate ceiling on personalisation
